title: a batch makes an item a copy of another item
what: `convert_many` reads an item that is another item with a numbered suffix as that item's copy where the graph holds it as no exact name at the release read, also where the item is Ensembl's own name (of another release, or of a database the graph does not hold), so the batch answers otherwise than the single call
user_action: convert such names one by one
fixed_by: built in idtrack's next version after its first round (tree `r1`): rule `batch_agrees_with_single`

title: `to_release` alone reads a string otherwise than `from_release` and `to_release` at that release
what: without `from_release` the reading of a string (a name or a synonym) is chosen by existence at the graph's last release and read at `to_release`: a string that is a name at the release asked and a synonym of another gene today (or the reverse) is answered otherwise than with `from_release` (rule `string_at_release`)
fixed_by: built in idtrack's next version after its first round (tree `r1`): rule `one_release_reading`
